segments.normalizedSource: The app’s main view displays four lines of text by creating a [`Text`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/SwiftUI/Text) instance for each line:

```swift struct SwiftUIText: View { /// The amount of spacing between each text entry. let spacing: CGFloat = 30 var body: some View { VStack(spacing: spacing) { // Set the style to large title. Text("This is a large title").font(.largeTitle) // Set the style to subheadline. Text("This is a subheadline text").font(.subheadline) // Format the text to bold. Text("This is a bold text").fontWeight(.bold) // Set the text's color to green. Text("This is a green text").foregroundStyle(.green) } } } ```
